description:
Manage the staging queue in buffer.md: capture entries, regroup, validate, and flush them into each thread's daily log at threads/<Kind>/<Name>/logs/<YYYY-MM-DD>.md.

Subcommands:
  add TEXT [--date DATE] — add an UNKNOWN raw capture (blocks flush until removed)
  add-text THREAD TEXT [--date DATE] — add a TEXT observation
  add-ref THREAD TARGET [SUMMARY] [--date DATE] — add a REF pointer to another vault file
  add-action THREAD TEXT [--due DATE] [--scheduled DATE] [--priority H|M|L] [--depends UUID8] [--date DATE] — add an ACTION (same as tasks add)
  list [FILTER] [--json] — show the buffer with line numbers
  rm LINE_NUMBER — remove one line
  tend — regroup by thread and date and validate; safe to repeat
  flush — tend, write each thread's daily log, clear the buffer, ingest flushed ACTIONs as tasks

Flags:
  global (before the subcommand):
    --quiet  suppress info output
  add, add-text, add-ref, add-action:
    --date YYYY-MM-DD  file under the day the thing happened (default today)
  add-ref:
    TARGET   <Kind>/<Name>, <Kind>/<Name>/hours, <Kind>/<Name>/payments, <Kind>/<Name>/logs/<YYYY-MM-DD>, a note stem, or people/<Name>
    SUMMARY  optional words shown after the link
  add-action:
    TEXT                    "(Assignee) description" or "description"
    --due YYYY-MM-DD        due date
    --scheduled YYYY-MM-DD  scheduled date
    --priority H|M|L
    --depends UUID8         full 8-char task uuid; repeatable
  list:
    FILTER  only lines containing this text, case-insensitive
    --json

Args:
  THREAD       thread name, 'Kind/Name' or wikilink
  LINE_NUMBER  integer from buffer list

Examples:
  ["add-text", "Projects/Northwind", "Validated the join semantics with Sam Rivera"]
  ["add-ref", "Projects/Northwind", "people/Sam Rivera", "call follow-up"]
  ["add-action", "Projects/Northwind", "(Sam Rivera) Send quarterly report", "--due", "2026-11-15"]
  ["flush"]

Notes:
  Use add-text, add-ref or add-action rather than add. An UNKNOWN entry fails tend and blocks flush until it is removed with rm and re-added with the right add-* command.
  Do not edit buffer.md directly.
  Line numbers change after rm or tend. Run list again before each rm.
  flush rewrites log files and empties the buffer. It already ingests tasks, so do not run tasks afterwards. Its report lines: 'already a task: <uuid> ...' (skipped), 'already buffered' (repeat), 'due updated: <uuid> ... due:<old> -> <new>' (only the due date differed), 'ambiguous' (matches several open tasks; nothing changed).
  Nothing prompts.
  Exit 1: line number not an integer, out of range or empty; validation failure (reason on stderr).
